svg.title: Use browser inspection to fix pages and collect data
svg.desc: In the first example, a website filter selects 2024 but the plot still shows 2023. The agent fixes the source, reloads and checks that the plot follows the filter. In the second, it inspects a public portal's release selector and download, then preserves the original data, source and release information, and collector script in a collection directory. These are distinct uses of browser access.
svg.text: The agent uses the browser to inspect and act
Find a repeatable way to collect data
The agent preserves the source and a reusable collection route
